title: How often should I service my AC in Al Wasl?
desc: For many residential systems, professional servicing every 3 to 6 months is suitable. Heavily used units may require more frequent maintenance.

title: Why is my AC cooling slowly?
desc: Slow cooling can be caused by dirty filters, restricted airflow, low refrigerant, blocked coils or thermostat problems. An inspection can identify the cause.

title: How much does AC repair cost in Al Wasl?
desc: Repair costs depend on the AC type, fault, spare parts and work required. An inspection gives a clearer idea of the actual repair needed.

title: What causes an AC to leak water?
desc:
Common causes include:
  • Blocked drain line
  • Frozen evaporator coil
  • Dirty air filter
  • Drainage blockage

title: How do I know if my AC needs a gas refill?
desc: Weak cooling alone does not confirm low refrigerant. A technician should check the refrigerant level and inspect for a possible leak before refilling.

title: Can AC cleaning improve indoor air quality?
desc: Yes. Cleaning filters, coils and drainage areas can remove accumulated dust, mould and other buildup that may affect indoor air quality.

title: Can I get same-day AC repair in Al Wasl?
desc: Same-day AC Repair may be available depending on technician availability, location and the nature of the AC problem.

title: What is included in AC maintenance?
desc:
A maintenance visit may include:
  • Filter cleaning
  • Coil inspection
  • Drain line checking
  • Thermostat testing
  • Cooling performance check

title: Which AC brands do you repair?
desc: We service major brands including Daikin, LG, Samsung, Carrier, Mitsubishi, O General, York, Gree, Panasonic and other commonly used brands.

title: Why does my AC make a rattling sound?
desc: Rattling can be caused by loose parts, fan problems, vibration or worn components. An inspection can help locate the source.

title: How can I reduce my AC electricity bill?
desc: Keep filters clean, maintain clear airflow, use sensible thermostat settings and arrange regular AC maintenance to help the system operate efficiently.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract useful for an AC?
desc: Yes. An AMC provides planned servicing and preventive checks. It can help identify developing faults before they turn into unexpected breakdowns.

title: Why is one room colder than another?
desc: Uneven cooling may result from restricted ducts, blocked filters, poor airflow, thermostat settings or an issue with the cooling system.

title: Is it better to repair or replace an old AC?
desc: Repair is often reasonable for smaller faults. Replacement may be worth considering when an older unit has repeated failures or major repair costs.

title: How can I book an AC service in Al Wasl?
desc: Provide your Al Wasl location, describe the AC problem and share your preferred service time with FAJ Technical Services L.L.C. The team can arrange a suitable visit.
